newsitem.title: USA: Republicans prepare lawsuit against Democrats.
newsitem.headline: Republicans prepare lawsuit against Democrats.

text.p: Republican Party Chairman Haley Barbour said Tuesday the party was preparing a lawsuit to force the Democratic Party to comply with the law and officially file its final contributions and expenditures report before the Nov. 5 election.
"We are looking at litigation" over the Democrats' failure to report contributions and expenditures for the first two weeks of October with the Federal Election Commission, Barbour told reporters.

The failure to file a final report followed two weeks of charges by Republican presidential nominee Bob Dole over what he said were questionable contributions to Democrats from people associated with Indonesian, Taiwanese and South Korean business interests.
Barbour said lawyers were working on litigation, and he would make an announcement at a later news conference.

"We want the Democrats to obey the law...and we want them to quit thumbing their nose at the public's right to know," Barbour said. "We want Bill Clinton to be held accountable for what the party is doing. He is head of the Democratic Party."

A spokeswoman at the Democratic National Committee, Susan Winegar, said the party would release to the press later in the day a list of contributions and expenditures for the first two weeks of October. "We are filing with the FEC on an expedited basis a pre-election report," she said, adding she did not know when it would be filed.
